title: How to Use Mistral AI: Models, API and Setup in 2026

facts.fact: Mistral AI was founded in April 2023 by Arthur Mensch, Guillaume Lample and Timothée Lacroix, according to the company's about page as cited in this guide.
facts.quote: Mistral AI was founded in April 2023 by Arthur Mensch, Guillaume Lample and Timothée Lacroix, according to the company's about page

facts.fact: This guide says Mistral announced on May 28, 2026 that Le Chat was renamed Vibe.
facts.quote: Mistral announced that "Le Chat is now Vibe" on May 28, 2026, with a Work mode for multi-step tasks and a Code mode

facts.fact: This guide states that the Studio developer console (formerly La Plateforme) is located at console.mistral.ai.
facts.quote: The developer console at console.mistral.ai, where you create API keys, test models, review usage and configure agents.

facts.fact: According to this guide's model table, Mistral Large 4 (v26.10, public preview) uses a MoE architecture with about 1.05T total parameters and 52B active parameters.
According to this guide's model table, Mistral Large 4 (v26.10, public preview) has a 1M-token context length and uses the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License.
According to this guide's model table, Mistral Medium 3.5 (v26.04) is a dense 128B model with a 256k-token context and a Modified MIT license for its open weights.
According to this guide's model table, Mistral Small 4 (v26.03) is a MoE model with 119B total parameters, about 6B active, a 256k-token context and an Apache 2.0 license.
facts.quote: MoE, 119B total, about 6B active | 256k tokens | Apache 2.0

facts.fact: According to this guide's model table, Mistral Large 3 (v25.12) is a MoE model with 675B total parameters, 41B active, a 256k-token context and an Apache 2.0 license.
According to this guide's model table, the Ministral 3 family (3B, 8B, 14B) has a 256k-token context for the 8B model card and is licensed under Apache 2.0.
facts.quote: Ministral 3 (3B, 8B, 14B) | Edge and on-device inference | Dense, base, instruct and reasoning variants | 256k tokens (8B card) | Apache 2.0

facts.fact: According to this guide's model table, Codestral (v25.08) has a 128k-token context and is available as Premier (API).
facts.quote: | Codestral (v25.08) | Code completion and fill-in-the-middle | Code model | 128k tokens | Premier (API) |

facts.fact: This guide says Mistral's August 2026 infrastructure announcement describes generally available regional endpoints that keep processing in Europe or the US, with limited safeguarded transfers to sub-processors.
facts.quote: describes generally available regional endpoints that keep processing in Europe or the US, with limited safeguarded transfers to sub-processors

facts.fact: This guide states that the model table reflects Mistral's models as of October 30, 2026, and that prices and plan details are a snapshot to be confirmed in official documentation.
facts.quote: Treat prices and plan details as a snapshot and confirm them in the official documentation.
